removedRows.title: signals
removedRows.notes: ★ 2026-08-05: the four board/panel defects recorded on 2026-08-05 are FIXED IN SOURCE against the frames; still `partial` because nothing was render-measured and the tablet/mobile tier is unbuilt. WHAT WAS FIXED. (1) PER-DIFFICULTY PALETTE. PlinkoGame.tsx now carries three ramps in PLINKO_BUCKET_RAMPS, each sampled bucket-by-bucket off its own frame: Easy (low) #90E3E7 #7DD4E7 #69C6E6 #57B8E6 #46ACE6 #349EE6 #2391E6 #1184E6 #0078E6 from 9069:6513; Medium #A1E03C #8ED639 #7ACD37 #67C334 #55BB31 #44B12F #34A72C #34A72C #1A9627 from 9095:5889; Hard (high) #E590F2 #DB85EE #D17CEB #C771E7 #BE68E3 #B45EE0 #AA55DC #A04CD9 #9744D5 from 9095:5332. Previously ONE ramp - the Easy one - was hardcoded and painted on all three, so Medium and Hard rendered the wrong colourway outright. (2) THE RAMP IS MIRRORED. Each array runs EDGE->CENTRE and getMultiplierSlotColor indexes it by distance from the centre bucket, so the row is symmetric exactly as all three frames draw it. The old getMultiplierSlotColors mapped t = index/(total-1) monotonically and colour-inverted the right half of every board; the comment asserting the frame was "NOT a symmetric center-out ramp" was itself the bug and is replaced - those nine stops were precisely the nine distinct colours of the mirrored HALF row. Resampling still works for the 8- and 12-row boards. Bucket chrome now matches too: flat fill instead of a vertical gradient, radius/border/foot held as the frame's ratios (4.565, 1.712 and 13.55 over 31.952 of slot height), inset bottom foot at rgba(0,0,0,0.2), the white 15% top highlight dropped (the frame has none), and text pinned to Green Coal 300 #001615 on every bucket rather than luminance-picked. (3) THREE BALL VARIANTS BUILT. 9137-10213/10215/10217 are flat 10px discs - confirmed from the exported SVGs, `<circle r="5">` with a single fill - at #56C7F3 Easy, #3BFF00 Medium, #DC4CE9 Hard. drawGame drew one r=7 orange-red radial gradient with a 14px glow and a white specular for all three; it now draws a flat r=5 disc keyed off riskLevel. Ball hues are NOT the bucket hues (the balls are more saturated), so they live in their own PLINKO_BALL_COLOR map. (4) AUTO PANEL. Label is the frame's "Number of Bets:", the field accepts 0, an infinity affordance sits at its trailing edge where the frame's 16x7 glyph is, and 0 now genuinely means unlimited - burstDrop runs to POSITIVE_INFINITY, placing one REAL playPlinko settlement per ball until stopped. The 25-ball cap is now understood as a RENDER budget: long and unlimited runs WAIT for headroom per tick instead of being trimmed, so the "Burst Trimmed" toast is gone. CTA relabelled "Bet" per 9104:6251. (5) PEGS, found while verifying the above and fixed with it. The peg SVGs export byte-identical from the Easy and Medium frames (9069:5872 vs 9095:5373), so pegs are NOT per-difficulty - the board's risk colour is carried entirely by the buckets and the ball. The frame draws a FLAT WHITE circle, r=3.42339 on a 34.234 column pitch, i.e. exactly 0.1 of the pitch. The code painted #EAF7FE (near-white with a blue tint) at a hardcoded r=3; it now paints #ffffff and derives the radius as pegSpacingX * 0.1 so the ratio holds at 8, 12 and 16 rows rather than being right at one row count. The sky-blue glow is KEPT: the frame's peg group contains a second ellipse ("Ellipse 38") that exports EMPTY, which is how a blur/glow effect layer comes back, so the frame does have a glow layer whose parameters could not be read - the existing rgba(86,199,243,0.30) stands in for it and is the one peg property still unverified. NOT reconciled the cheap way: neither rail was touched (restoring 777 IS the documented exploit) and the client constant was not raised to meet it. Confirmed absent from the rendered page.
